title: Snake waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4CE06B'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#38C85A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2AAE4C'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Coiled tail base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='30' ry='11' fill='#2AAE4C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='9' fill='#38C85A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='20' ry='6.5' fill='#4CE06B'/>

  <!-- Body rising from coil -->
  <path d='M50 80 C50 70 62 68 64 58 C66 48 56 44 52 36' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Belly stripe on body -->
  <path d='M50 74 C50 67 59 65 61 57 C63 50 57 46 54 40' fill='none' stroke='#B8F5A0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d='M57 46 C68 42 70 30 74 22' fill='none' stroke='#38C85A' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 46 C68 42 70 30 74 22' fill='none' stroke='#7CF08C' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Hand / little tip -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='20' r='6' fill='#4CE06B'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='20' r='3' fill='#B8F5A0'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='30' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#4CE06B'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='31' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#5CE87A'/>

  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='35' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7CF08C'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#0E3B1A'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#0E3B1A'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='26' r='1.3' fill='#E8FFE0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='1.3' fill='#E8FFE0'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 37 Q44 41 49 38' fill='none' stroke='#0E3B1A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tongue -->
  <path d='M37 37 L31 39 M31 39 L29 37 M31 39 L29 41' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B8A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Cheek blob -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#FF9BB3' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
